autoblockrefiller.missing_mycel: Mycel is missing. %s needs the Mycel library to work and stays off until it is installed.
autoblockrefiller.cmd.click_hint: Click a value to change it. Hover a setting to see what it does.
autoblockrefiller.cmd.all_reset: Every setting is back to its default.
autoblockrefiller.cmd.no_setting: There is no setting called '%1$s'. Type /%2$s to see them all.
autoblockrefiller.refill.no_toggle: This server does not let players turn refilling off for themselves.
autoblockrefiller.config.enabled.desc: Whether empty slots are refilled automatically.
autoblockrefiller.config.searchHotbar.de: Also take refills from other hotbar slots (the main inventory is always searched).
autoblockrefiller.config.refillItems.des: Also refill items used up by right-clicking, like snowballs, ender pearls, firework rockets and bone meal.
autoblockrefiller.config.refillSound.des: Play a quiet sound, only for that player, when a slot is refilled.
autoblockrefiller.config.runningLowWarni: Show a note above the hotbar when the last stack goes in, or when nothing is left to refill with.
autoblockrefiller.config.playerToggle.de: Let every player turn refilling off for themselves with /autoblockrefiller toggle.
autoblockrefiller.config.winter.desc: Winter update: refills sparkle with snowflakes and chime like sleigh bells, and snowballs always refill.
